Initial meeting to discuss the project scope and deliverables with the Horizon Pioneers team. Make sure to prepare the project outline and initial resource allocation. Additionally, it was mentioned that an attendee will need to leave by 3 PM for a personal appointment.

Personal Note: Lisa Wong told me that she expects to have a baby, so I am not sure how much she can contribute to the project. This is something unsettled yet.

A full-day event to foster team spirit and collaboration. Remember to bring comfortable clothing and a positive attitude! Note: Special menu requests have been made to accommodate dietary needs of an attendee.
